notes: Scope: figures added only to the four gold-tier coordinate-circle problems, where a line cutting a circle x²+y²=r² is exactly the figure a GCSE exam prints. Each SVG is generated programmatically: radius = sqrt(r²)×scale, intersection dots placed from the stored solutions (verified to lie on the circle to <0.1px; the amber line passes through both dots), only equations that are given in the problem are labelled, and the intersection coordinates are hidden behind ? so the figure never reveals the answer. 'Diagram not drawn accurately' caption on each. Theme-safe: all text/strokes currentColor, region fill #60a5fa @0.15 opacity, points/line #f59e0b; internal clipPath ref only, no external resources; each display ~1.5KB. The linear-and-quadratic (parabola) bank problems (all bronze/silver plus gold[4]) were deliberately left figureless: they are pure algebraic-solve items the exam prints WITHOUT a graph, so a parabola sketch would be decoration (spec discourages) and would risk turning algebra practice into graph-reading. Opener left unchanged (its guess-the-number hook must stay figure-free so box 1 is answerable by common sense; its reveal only describes, not claims, a figure). No question text, solutions, guided_steps, misconceptions, hints, method_card, tier_guides, worked_examples, related_videos or topic_links altered: diff vs pre-PATCH live shows exactly 4 changed paths (gold[0..3].display).
